newsitem.title: SPAIN: ATHLETICS-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION MASSANA TO MISS ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION MASSANA TO MISS ATHENS.

text.p: Former world 20-km walk champion Valentin Massana of Spain said on Friday he would not take part in the Athens world championships next month.

Massana, 27, who said he did not plan to take part in any international competitions this year, won the 20-km gold medal at the Stuttgart world championships and the silver two years ago in Gothenburg.
He won the bronze medal in last year's Atlanta Olympics.
